steps.description: Explore the design space for small-capacity feedforward networks to test the hypothesis that bootstrap solution space rigidity enables zero-violation generalization on held-out constraints. Systematically vary network capacity (width/depth), constraint types (linear/convex), and bootstrap sample sizes to identify critical capacity thresholds where generalization error drops to zero. Use numerical experiments to quantify the relationship between model capacity and solution space rigidity.
